model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

model.precedence: This common model and materialized module effective_spec replace only listed fields. Original packages are immutable historical baseline; accepted S1/IO behavior remains unchanged. No Owner adoption inferred from request to prepare revisions.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_types.Context: project_uuid/document_uuid/session_id/owner_generation/captured_revision/operation_id; UI strings decoded to existing typed IDs/u64; not label authority.

proof_types.ResolutionSnapshot: {Context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; no root_proof_id; complete resolution is neither pin nor root completeness.
proof_types.VerifiedBundle: {context,source_digest,entries:[asset_id,digest,size_bytes,verified_bytes_or_handle],legacy_alias_mapping}; all raw bytes/hash/closure validated by trusted issuer.
proof_types.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer_receipt_id resolves server record {issuer,operation_kind,Context,target_identity,receipt/raw/projection evidence}; durable proof must be revalidated after restart; UI DTO never carries trusted receipt content.
proof_types.TransferReceipt: {issuer:M05,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,root_manifest_ids,external_proof_id,Context,receipt_id}; original Held transitions only after verified durable catalog commit.
proof_types.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.

quarantine_copy.marker: .sgenaxis/copy-state.v1.json; {schema:SGA-PROJECT-COPY-v1,project_uuid,operation_id,state:Quarantined|Ready,definition_raw_digest?,document_raw_digest?,catalog_raw_digest?,manifest_digest?}. Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
quarantine_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

source_reservation.application_trait: SourceReadReservation: snapshot_id()->SourceSnapshotId; validate_held()->Result<SourceSnapshotId,SourceFenceError>; explicit release(self). Owns authenticated snapshot identity+held producer read capability; cannot be constructed from DTO. Drop releases handles only.
source_reservation.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. No create/repair/cleanup. Missing sidecar =>Unavailable.
source_reservation.producer_rules: Definition/design owner read reservation blocks their mutation and exclusive file writer until generation terminal result; acquire definition→approval HOST epoch→design before active writer. Immutable SPEC Approved revisions remain pure; HOST epoch covers evidence validity changes, not a SPEC filesystem dependency. All producer mutation routes must honor reservation; incomplete coverage =>DependencyNotReady.
source_reservation.io_guard: IO-owned crate-private CommittedReadGuard unforgeable outside adapter constructor. inspect_committed_locked(&CommittedReadGuard)->Result<CommittedReadInspection,CommitError>; validates guard-bound canonical target/terminal journal/current raw digest, no path argument replacement. Public FileCommitPort unchanged.
source_reservation.scope: New committed_read.rs ports/adapter/native tests plus generation_sources.rs application provider adapters. Only proposed exact child files below; accepted IO implementation not re-approved automatically.

recovery_readiness.LocalIntegrityReady: Native coherent recovery index+payload+ALL material copies and hashes/schema verified; independent from original catalog availability.
recovery_readiness.PublicationAcknowledged: Original M05 root transfer receipt and original captured S1 Published/ACK verified.
recovery_readiness.restore: LocalIntegrityReady permits explicit restore to authorized destination even SourceRetentionDeferred. Destination import+durable pin+M04 new-unsaved install mandatory; original Held/Unknown retained and no fake original Published/ACK. Missing/corrupt local blob always blocks.

reservation_kinds.FormalWriteReservation: blocks same-owner content edits until matching IO completion; read diagnostics allowed.
reservation_kinds.RecoveryAttemptReservation: one recovery attempt; after immutable capture+pin, live healthy owner may edit. Never reuse formal saving state for whole recovery copy pipeline.
reservation_kinds.CatalogLease: short transition only, no callbacks into document owner while held.

U64Decimal.semantic_validation: parse checked u64 <=18446744073709551615; reject JSON number; never JS Number conversion

wire_schema.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
replay_protocol.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. Exact bytes document fixtures required before RED.
replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

proof_registry_record.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here

proof_registry_record.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
proof_registry_record.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
proof_registry_record.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

store_read_contract.grant: Crate-private trusted constructor in M05 application composition: immutable store_identity,pin_id,workflow_id,asset_id,digest,size,pin_catalog_generation; issued only after verified Held or Transferred pin membership. Released pin denied. Not deserializable from UI.
store_read_contract.preconditions: 0 < max_bytes <= M05 existing admitted blob limit; expected_size<=max_bytes; grant exact pair/size/store matches. Acquire safe native immutable object handle, reject alias/reparse/size/hash mismatch, no path/URI returned as authority.
store_read_contract.result: VerifiedBlobRead {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,immutable bounded bytes or guarded read handle}. Stream exactly expected_size, hash entire bytes before consumer install/export. Handle lifetime owns source access; no reopen-by-path.
store_read_contract.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

mutation_wire_result.precommit_error: {ok:false,error:closed existing error}; zero content commit. Once S1 commit occurred cannot use ErrorUnchanged, undo rollback or failed toast implying no effect.
mutation_wire_result.ui: Show installed revision plus material retention pending; preserve Held, disable unsafe pin release/export until proofs complete. Replay returns original result, never reapply or overwrite newer projection. Writer transfer has separate BindingProjection result, never fabricate mutation/history.

wire_schema.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

after.trace_policy: Every preserved original row has immutable SHA and explicit unchanged or protocol-only amendment; detailed named inputs/call logs in rr fixtures supplement original behavior. No original behavior case removed.
after.fixture_gate: Each planned test must materialize closed inputs and independent expected byte/call sequence before valid RED. This document supplies exact RR phase examples, not product executable tests.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

model.precedence: This common model and materialized module effective_spec replace only listed fields. Original packages are immutable historical baseline; accepted S1/IO behavior remains unchanged. No Owner adoption inferred from request to prepare revisions.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_types.Context: project_uuid/document_uuid/session_id/owner_generation/captured_revision/operation_id; UI strings decoded to existing typed IDs/u64; not label authority.

proof_types.ResolutionSnapshot: {Context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; no root_proof_id; complete resolution is neither pin nor root completeness.
proof_types.VerifiedBundle: {context,source_digest,entries:[asset_id,digest,size_bytes,verified_bytes_or_handle],legacy_alias_mapping}; all raw bytes/hash/closure validated by trusted issuer.
proof_types.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer_receipt_id resolves server record {issuer,operation_kind,Context,target_identity,receipt/raw/projection evidence}; durable proof must be revalidated after restart; UI DTO never carries trusted receipt content.
proof_types.TransferReceipt: {issuer:M05,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,root_manifest_ids,external_proof_id,Context,receipt_id}; original Held transitions only after verified durable catalog commit.
proof_types.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.

quarantine_copy.marker: .sgenaxis/copy-state.v1.json; {schema:SGA-PROJECT-COPY-v1,project_uuid,operation_id,state:Quarantined|Ready,definition_raw_digest?,document_raw_digest?,catalog_raw_digest?,manifest_digest?}. Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
quarantine_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

source_reservation.application_trait: SourceReadReservation: snapshot_id()->SourceSnapshotId; validate_held()->Result<SourceSnapshotId,SourceFenceError>; explicit release(self). Owns authenticated snapshot identity+held producer read capability; cannot be constructed from DTO. Drop releases handles only.
source_reservation.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. No create/repair/cleanup. Missing sidecar =>Unavailable.
source_reservation.producer_rules: Definition/design owner read reservation blocks their mutation and exclusive file writer until generation terminal result; acquire definition→approval HOST epoch→design before active writer. model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.

model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.

source_reservation.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
replay_protocol.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
replay_protocol.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

quarantine_copy.marker: .sgenaxis/copy-state.v1.json; {schema:SGA-PROJECT-COPY-v1,project_uuid,operation_id,state:Quarantined|Ready,definition_raw_digest?,document_raw_digest?,catalog_raw_digest?,manifest_digest?}. Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
quarantine_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

source_reservation.application_trait: SourceReadReservation: snapshot_id()->SourceSnapshotId; validate_held()->Result<SourceSnapshotId,SourceFenceError>; explicit release(self). Owns authenticated snapshot identity+held producer read capability; cannot be constructed from DTO. Drop releases handles only.
source_reservation.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. No create/repair/cleanup. Missing sidecar =>Unavailable.
source_reservation.producer_rules: Definition/design owner read reservation blocks their mutation and exclusive file writer until generation terminal result; acquire definition→approval HOST epoch→design before active writer. Immutable SPEC Approved revisions remain pure; HOST epoch covers evidence validity changes, not a SPEC filesystem dependency. All producer mutation routes must honor reservation; incomplete coverage =>DependencyNotReady.
source_reservation.io_guard: IO-owned crate-private CommittedReadGuard unforgeable outside adapter constructor. inspect_committed_locked(&CommittedReadGuard)->Result<CommittedReadInspection,CommitError>; validates guard-bound canonical target/terminal journal/current raw digest, no path argument replacement. Public FileCommitPort unchanged.
source_reservation.scope: New committed_read.rs ports/adapter/native tests plus generation_sources.rs application provider adapters. Only proposed exact child files below; accepted IO implementation not re-approved automatically.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
replay_protocol.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. Exact bytes document fixtures required before RED.
replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

proof_registry_record.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here

proof_registry_record.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
proof_registry_record.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
proof_registry_record.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

store_read_contract.grant: Crate-private trusted constructor in M05 application composition: immutable store_identity,pin_id,workflow_id,asset_id,digest,size,pin_catalog_generation; issued only after verified Held or Transferred pin membership. Released pin denied. Not deserializable from UI.
store_read_contract.preconditions: 0 < max_bytes <= M05 existing admitted blob limit; expected_size<=max_bytes; grant exact pair/size/store matches. Acquire safe native immutable object handle, reject alias/reparse/size/hash mismatch, no path/URI returned as authority.
store_read_contract.result: VerifiedBlobRead {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,immutable bounded bytes or guarded read handle}. Stream exactly expected_size, hash entire bytes before consumer install/export. Handle lifetime owns source access; no reopen-by-path.
store_read_contract.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

mutation_wire_result.precommit_error: {ok:false,error:closed existing error}; zero content commit. Once S1 commit occurred cannot use ErrorUnchanged, undo rollback or failed toast implying no effect.
mutation_wire_result.ui: Show installed revision plus material retention pending; preserve Held, disable unsafe pin release/export until proofs complete. Replay returns original result, never reapply or overwrite newer projection. Writer transfer has separate BindingProjection result, never fabricate mutation/history.

before.response: Tagged Result {ok:{kind,payload}}|{error:DocumentError}. Projection {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_uuid,generation,revision,format,semantic_profile,dirty,can_mutate,health,pending_binding_ids,blocked_capabilities}; no mutable S1 handle exposed.
before.raw_ingress: Outer Tauri JSON already decoded: no guarantee outer duplicates/size-before-allocation. Only inner source_text/design_json guarded before typed decode. Bad payload never invokes S1 commit.
before.migration: Existing scene_save/scene_load text routes and design typed save/load/build fail closed DOCUMENT_OWNER_REQUIRED or DESIGN_OWNER_REQUIRED; no fallback to direct FS. M03 facade submits design mutation into same owner using inner raw JSON. Remove JS confirmLeaveSceneIfDirty authority and retainUiExclusiveNodes/clamp normalization from persistence path; UI uses projection and separate explicit edit.

ui_schema.DocumentPanel: Open/Save/SaveAs/Undo/Clear/Close controls; revision and health shown; mutation disabled unless current writer+Healthy. Clear preview exact section counts/paths, confirm/cancel, expired preview requests refresh.
ui_schema.errors: Inline structured error summary, pending save proof query, no success toast on deferred ACK; preserve unsaved text on rejection.
ui_schema.accessibility: Keyboard controls; focus stays on failed action; status aria-live polite; blocked actions explanation accessible.

after.response: Closed tagged result; Projection uses projection_schema; mutation uses common mutation_wire_result; save uses existing formal proof/deferred outcomes. Error expected/observed revision and generation also U64Decimal. No raw u64 JSON number.
after.raw_ingress: Outer Tauri JSON already decoded: no guarantee outer duplicates/size-before-allocation. Only inner source_text/design_json guarded before typed decode. Bad payload never invokes S1 commit.
after.migration: Existing scene_save/scene_load text routes and design typed save/load/build fail closed DOCUMENT_OWNER_REQUIRED or DESIGN_OWNER_REQUIRED; no fallback to direct FS. Remove JS confirmLeaveSceneIfDirty authority and retainUiExclusiveNodes/clamp normalization from persistence path; UI uses projection and separate explicit edit.

after.A: Acquire FormalWriteReservation R7; edits Busy until IO completion.
after.B: Verify IO receipt or classify uncertain. Release write reservation on classified terminal IO completion; on mismatch RecoveryBlocked prohibits mutation.
after.C: With verified file receipt, Healthy owner may edit R8 while root-transfer/semantic ACK R7 deferred. Captured proof remains immutable; ACK R7 never cleans R8.
after.D: RecoveryAttempt only holds immutable capture fence through capture+pin; live edits after it are allowed. No formal baseline advance from recovery ACK.

after: WorkflowContext immutable across child calls; derive per-role TransitionKey per common replay_protocol. Existing UI request UUID is runtime request ID, not reused as catalog operation key. Pin receipt never proves runtime content commit or formal ACK.

concrete_fields.previous: Closed DTO; expected_revision/generation/count/epoch/size fields use U64Decimal strings on wire; internal Rust u64 unchanged. Trusted actual caller and native identity required.

after.default_for_declared_internal_u64: All other proposed UI inputs/outputs/errors with typed u64 field must use common U64Decimal; source format numeric data/persisted schema excluded. Exact command DTO fixture coverage remains acceptance gate, not inferred from prose.

acceptance: All proposed decisions adopted as same revision, no missing architecture seam hidden
Skeleton compiles and accepted separately before effective RED
Every case traceable; assertion-level expected values and fixture self-check before valid RED
Focused/module/adjacent regressions GREEN or exact classified failures; no old tests weakened
Architecture review verifies one owner/Ports/health/semantic ACK; no journal ownership move
Windows11 native aliases/lease gates separately measured; NOT RUN remains NOT RUN
Missing real target/material/pin provider means integration BLOCKED, never product completion
Parent M04 full PREP and complete recovery/M03 release remain separate acceptance
pending_automation: Implement step definitions only after approval/Skeleton; current stubs are documentation text
Build independent XML output oracle and fixture self-checks before future product RED
Native Windows11 target identity/reparse/8.3 fixtures require environment
Material/pin provider real integration needs separate accepted envelope
before.regression: Existing S1 history, IO220/Ports101/HOST330 historical baselines not rerun for proposal progress. Future run fresh relevant suites after implementation; classify setup/fixture/env/flaky/WIP/spec/regression separately.

after.effective_test_plan: cx_test_plan with per-row case_trace; original oracle preserved

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

model.precedence: This common model and materialized module effective_spec replace only listed fields. Original packages are immutable historical baseline; accepted S1/IO behavior remains unchanged. No Owner adoption inferred from request to prepare revisions.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.

wire_types.Context: project_uuid/document_uuid/session_id/owner_generation/captured_revision/operation_id; UI strings decoded to existing typed IDs/u64; not label authority.

proof_types.ResolutionSnapshot: {Context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; no root_proof_id; complete resolution is neither pin nor root completeness.
proof_types.VerifiedBundle: {context,source_digest,entries:[asset_id,digest,size_bytes,verified_bytes_or_handle],legacy_alias_mapping}; all raw bytes/hash/closure validated by trusted issuer.
proof_types.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer_receipt_id resolves server record {issuer,operation_kind,Context,target_identity,receipt/raw/projection evidence}; durable proof must be revalidated after restart; UI DTO never carries trusted receipt content.
proof_types.TransferReceipt: {issuer:M05,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,root_manifest_ids,external_proof_id,Context,receipt_id}; original Held transitions only after verified durable catalog commit.
proof_types.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.

quarantine_copy.marker: .sgenaxis/copy-state.v1.json; {schema:SGA-PROJECT-COPY-v1,project_uuid,operation_id,state:Quarantined|Ready,definition_raw_digest?,document_raw_digest?,catalog_raw_digest?,manifest_digest?}. Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
quarantine_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

source_reservation.application_trait: SourceReadReservation: snapshot_id()->SourceSnapshotId; validate_held()->Result<SourceSnapshotId,SourceFenceError>; explicit release(self). Owns authenticated snapshot identity+held producer read capability; cannot be constructed from DTO. Drop releases handles only.
source_reservation.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. No create/repair/cleanup. Missing sidecar =>Unavailable.
source_reservation.producer_rules: Definition/design owner read reservation blocks their mutation and exclusive file writer until generation terminal result; acquire definition→approval HOST epoch→design before active writer. Immutable SPEC Approved revisions remain pure; HOST epoch covers evidence validity changes, not a SPEC filesystem dependency. All producer mutation routes must honor reservation; incomplete coverage =>DependencyNotReady.
source_reservation.io_guard: IO-owned crate-private CommittedReadGuard unforgeable outside adapter constructor. inspect_committed_locked(&CommittedReadGuard)->Result<CommittedReadInspection,CommitError>; validates guard-bound canonical target/terminal journal/current raw digest, no path argument replacement. Public FileCommitPort unchanged.
source_reservation.scope: New committed_read.rs ports/adapter/native tests plus generation_sources.rs application provider adapters. Only proposed exact child files below; accepted IO implementation not re-approved automatically.

recovery_readiness.LocalIntegrityReady: Native coherent recovery index+payload+ALL material copies and hashes/schema verified; independent from original catalog availability.
recovery_readiness.PublicationAcknowledged: Original M05 root transfer receipt and original captured S1 Published/ACK verified.
recovery_readiness.restore: LocalIntegrityReady permits explicit restore to authorized destination even SourceRetentionDeferred. Destination import+durable pin+M04 new-unsaved install mandatory; original Held/Unknown retained and no fake original Published/ACK. Missing/corrupt local blob always blocks.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

wire_schema.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
replay_protocol.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. Exact bytes document fixtures required before RED.
replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

proof_registry_record.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here

proof_registry_record.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
proof_registry_record.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
proof_registry_record.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

store_read_contract.grant: Crate-private trusted constructor in M05 application composition: immutable store_identity,pin_id,workflow_id,asset_id,digest,size,pin_catalog_generation; issued only after verified Held or Transferred pin membership. Released pin denied. Not deserializable from UI.
store_read_contract.preconditions: 0 < max_bytes <= M05 existing admitted blob limit; expected_size<=max_bytes; grant exact pair/size/store matches. Acquire safe native immutable object handle, reject alias/reparse/size/hash mismatch, no path/URI returned as authority.
store_read_contract.result: VerifiedBlobRead {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,immutable bounded bytes or guarded read handle}. Stream exactly expected_size, hash entire bytes before consumer install/export. Handle lifetime owns source access; no reopen-by-path.
store_read_contract.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

mutation_wire_result.ui: Show installed revision plus material retention pending; preserve Held, disable unsafe pin release/export until proofs complete. Replay returns original result, never reapply or overwrite newer projection. Writer transfer has separate BindingProjection result, never fabricate mutation/history.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

model.precedence: This common model and materialized module effective_spec replace only listed fields. Original packages are immutable historical baseline; accepted S1/IO behavior remains unchanged. No Owner adoption inferred from request to prepare revisions.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_types.Context: project_uuid/document_uuid/session_id/owner_generation/captured_revision/operation_id; UI strings decoded to existing typed IDs/u64; not label authority.

proof_types.ResolutionSnapshot: {Context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; no root_proof_id; complete resolution is neither pin nor root completeness.
proof_types.VerifiedBundle: {context,source_digest,entries:[asset_id,digest,size_bytes,verified_bytes_or_handle],legacy_alias_mapping}; all raw bytes/hash/closure validated by trusted issuer.
proof_types.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer_receipt_id resolves server record {issuer,operation_kind,Context,target_identity,receipt/raw/projection evidence}; durable proof must be revalidated after restart; UI DTO never carries trusted receipt content.

Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
replay_protocol.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. Exact bytes document fixtures required before RED.
replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

proof_registry_record.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
proof_registry_record.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
proof_registry_record.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

store_read_contract.preconditions: 0 < max_bytes <= M05 existing admitted blob limit; expected_size<=max_bytes; grant exact pair/size/store matches. Acquire safe native immutable object handle, reject alias/reparse/size/hash mismatch, no path/URI returned as authority.
store_read_contract.result: VerifiedBlobRead {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,immutable bounded bytes or guarded read handle}. Stream exactly expected_size, hash entire bytes before consumer install/export. Handle lifetime owns source access; no reopen-by-path.
store_read_contract.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
replay_protocol.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

proof_registry_record.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.

store_read_contract.result: VerifiedBlobRead {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,immutable bounded bytes or guarded read handle}. Stream exactly expected_size, hash entire bytes before consumer install/export. Handle lifetime owns source access; no reopen-by-path.
store_read_contract.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

after.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer receipt lookup with issuer/kind/WorkflowContext/target/evidence validation per proof_registry_record; no trusted DTO body. Missing runtime-only issuer record => UnverifiedOutcome.
after.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.

after.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
after.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
after.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
after.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. Exact bytes document fixtures required before RED.
after.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
after.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
after.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

after.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here

after.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
after.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
after.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

U64Decimal.semantic_validation: parse checked u64 <=18446744073709551615; reject JSON number; never JS Number conversion

after.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

after: WorkflowContext immutable across child calls; derive per-role TransitionKey per common replay_protocol. Existing UI request UUID is runtime request ID, not reused as catalog operation key. Pin receipt never proves runtime content commit or formal ACK.

after.default_for_declared_internal_u64: All other proposed UI inputs/outputs/errors with typed u64 field must use common U64Decimal; source format numeric data/persisted schema excluded. Exact command DTO fixture coverage remains acceptance gate, not inferred from prose.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case.
